classification.difficultyReason: The unknown is on the first rectangle, so the scale runs backwards (factor 3/4). The student finds A's height and then its area. This is slightly more than the direct rectangle-area item.

content.prompt:
These rectangles are similar.
Find the area of rectangle $A$.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the height of rectangle $A$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{h}{16}&=\frac{7.5}{10}\\h&=16\times\frac{7.5}{10}\\h&=12\text{ cm}\\\text{Area of }A&=7.5\times12\\&=90\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
